paragraphs: An outbreak of Salmonella Telelkebir linked to raw oysters remains ongoing, with 28 cases reported across 13 states and 5 hospitalizations as of October 30 [1]. Several food recalls are in effect: Vitality Works is recalling 365 Whole Foods Market Ashwagandha Capsules (lot 2025-26227) due to potential Salmonella contamination [3]; HAIFA SMOKED FISH is recalling Cold Smoked Sprats because of potential Clostridium botulinum contamination, which can cause life-threatening illness [6]; and Taylor Farms is recalling H-E-B Backyard BBQ Chop Salad kits due to undeclared soy and almonds [5]. Additionally, SLR Food Distribution is recalling Wise Wife Brand Ground Cinnamon because of elevated lead levels [4].

An FDA warning covers all flavors, quantities, lots, and dates of Once Upon A Farm Tractor Wheels Organic Toddler Soft-Baked Bars after reports of infants choking [9]. The FDA declared an end to the Salmonella outbreak linked to Trader Joe's chicken wraps, though a new outbreak is under investigation [14].
